g: (African-American Vernacular, slang) A young black male, especially within urban black communities.
(African-American Vernacular, archetypal, slang) A young black male perceived as participating in or embodying street culture, often implying recklessness, criminality, or gang involvement.
A bird of South America, Rhynchotus rufescens, the red-winged tinamou.
(organic chemistry) Any disubstituted compound having an amido group attached to an acetylene group
(organic chemistry) Any disubstituted compound having an amino group attached to an acetylene group
(organic chemistry) An ynol with hydroxyl groups on each side of its triple bond.
A type of two-man keelboat from Norway.
And what a terrific performance by our girls in the Yngling. […] A strange name - do you Yngle it or sail it.
(biochemistry) The furanose form of an ynose
(chemistry) Any compound having a hydroxyl group directly attached to an acetylene group; they are tautomeric with ketenes.
(organic chemistry) Any anion derived from an ynol; any salt containing such an anion
(organic chemistry) Any compound having a keto group attached to an acetylene group
